title: Koofay may Karbala ka ye manzar ayaan hua
body:
Mola mera shaheed ba waqt e azaan hua
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis ne charagh e khana e Kaaba bujha diya
Taza Hasan Hussain pe madar ka gham hua
Roeen zameen nalan kuna aasmaan hua
Mola mera shaheed ba waqt e azaan hua
<<DIVIDER>>
Baqi tha aik sajda ke talwar chal gayi
Is gham may nabz e arz o sama doobnay lagay
Quran Murtaza ke liye noha khawan hua
Mola mera shaheed ba waqt e azaan hua
<<DIVIDER>>
Rozay pe roza rakhay huay rozay dar tha
Islam keh raha hay shah e zulfiqar tha
Ham se Nabi ke deen ka chahra juda hua
Mola mera shaheed ba waqt e azaan hua
<<DIVIDER>>
Hasnain kaise dagh e yateemi uthayain gay
Abbas baba keh ke kisay ab bulayain gay
Barpa zameen o arsh pe shor e fughaan hua
Mola mera shaheed ba waqt e azaan hua
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehan Aazmi saf e matam bichayey
Farsh e aza pe baith ke ansoo bahayey
Ye saneha Batool ke ghar na gahan hua
Mola mera shaheed ba waqt e azaan hua
